components.label: Total Investments
components.source: filing accession 0001193125-26-221880, schedule of investments table 7 row 32: Total Investments (277.4%) fair value 1,239,482,127

evidence.quote: Table 7 rows 25, 28, and 31 show Total Debt & Equity Investments fair value 657,323,982; Total Cash Equivalents fair value 13,933,721; Total Short-term Investments fair value 568,224,424.
Balance sheet table 18 row 14: Total Assets | $ | 1,249,314 | $ | 1,205,245 (amounts in thousands).

rationale: The schedule presents a final Total Investments row after the debt and equity, cash equivalents, and short-term investment subtotals. Its fair value of 1,239,482,127 equals 657,323,982 + 13,933,721 + 568,224,424 and is 99.2% of total assets of 1,249,314,000, leaving a plausible non-investment remainder of 9,831,873. The companyfacts fair value captured only the Total Debt & Equity Investments subtotal and excluded cash equivalents and short-term investments.
